question: Find the compound interest on a sum of ₹50,000 at the rate of 6% per annum to be compounded half yearly at the end of 2 years. (Approximate to the nearest integer.)
solution:
**Given**

Principal = ₹50,000

Rate of interest = 6% per annum

Compounding frequency = half yearly

Time = 2 years

**Concept:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾ - P

**Calculation:**

Compound Interest = 50000(1 + 0.06/2)⁽² × ²⁾ - 50000
